input.message: The twin room is built: two single beds along the west wall, a desk and chair on the east wall, a mirror, wall lights, a picture, and a floor-to-ceiling glass door at the far end. Four items still differ from the photo and I couldn't fix them with the tools. The blue striped curtains were refused because the tools only hang curtains on a window, not a door. There is no backpack part, and the accent part must stand on another piece, so the black backpack is missing. The west-wall wood panelling and teal band render only as a faint line. The sconces are small square lights rather than round white ones.
